details:
I previously reported this issue (https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/performance-degradation-with-abnormal-log-spam). Initially it occurred sporadically and could be temporarily resolved by restarting the game. However, after today's update, the issue has become 100% reproducible.

Typical Behavior:

    Normal operation: Smooth experience (FPS >70 on most days, standard log size)

    Current issue: Severe performance drop (FPS <60, log files expanding 1500x with repeated error messages)

Reproduction Steps:

1. Join the WannaDance world (wrld_8ac0b9db-17ae-44af-9d20-7d8ab94a9129) - preferably an instance with multiple existing players

2. Observe performance degradation over time:

    Rapid log file growth becomes apparent

    Significant FPS drop occurs

3. Interact with persistent storage:

    Favorite a song using the right wall interface (song IDs are stored via persistent storage)

4. Verify storage malfunction:

    Rejoin the world after 30 seconds

    Check the favorites list to confirm the newly added song ID is missing

    Note: Previously stored favorites remain intact and readable

Additional Observations:

    The persistent storage issue (steps 3-4) previously worked correctly in most cases

    Current status: 100% failure rate after today's update

    Strong indication that the update introduced this regression
title: Triple Issues: FPS Drops + Log Spam + Persistent Storage Failure
